project_tracker_diagnostic: Strongly branched plant with a broomy look; many small yellow heads; narrow leaves; whole-plant architecture is one of the best identification characters.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, narrow, linear to oblanceolate, often becoming reduced upward.
morphology_keys.heads: Many small discoid or nearly discoid yellow heads clustered toward branch ends.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae with a pappus of scales.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
